title: Quantitative Fourier Restriction Estimates for Weyl Operators: Fourier-Support Dependence and Lower Bounds
summary: The Weyl calculus associates a function $a$ on phase space $\mathbb{R}^{2d}$ with the corresponding Weyl operator $L_a$ acting on $L^2(\mathbb{R}^d)$. At $p=2$, this correspondence is governed by an exact Hilbert--Schmidt identity. For $p\neq2$, two-sided $L^p$--Schatten estimates are known for Paley--Wiener type symbols, with constants depending on the Fourier-support scale. We study this quantitative dependence, improve the known upper bounds, and show that in large ranges of $p$ no support-independent global comparison can hold.
